scope: running / processing / thinking, zero-indexed row 7, six frames only
review_method: Visual inspection of the six-frame contact sheet at native 192x208 and 48x52 display sizes, individual transparent frames 01, 03 and 05, and canonical character reference. Ordered still frames were inspected; actual animated playback was not observed by this reviewer.
evidence: All six portraits preserve silver-white wavy hair, violet eyes, pale segmented curved horns, curled ahoge, pointed ears and the rosette/tassel on screen-right.
The enlarged face remains readable at 48x52. Open eyes, half blink and full closed blink are visibly distinct.
Both horns, ahoge, hair and shoulder/bust contour are complete. No neighboring portrait bleed, clipped silhouette, detached hand or loose effects are visible.
The index finger rests on the chin and remains attached through the hand, sleeve and shoulder silhouette.
The ordered sequence reads as thoughtful chin rest, slight head tilt and gaze change, lowered eyelids, closed blink and return to a focused neutral pose.
Head size and registration remain coherent. Frame 6 is visually close to frame 1, supporting a loop; temporal smoothness must be assessed from the final encoded preview.
